currentContext.expansion: Macfos is an asset-light e-commerce and distribution platform, and the annual report describes expansion in terms of footprint, technology build-out and product development rather than plant capacity or a rupee capex programme. The Company states it operates 50,000+ sq. ft. of warehousing infrastructure alongside technology platforms and nationwide fulfilment capabilities that let it manage a 1,00,000+ SKU portfolio, and that it 'has continued to invest in Infrastructure, Technology, People and Customer experience while maintaining a focus on sustainable and profitable growth'. Under 'ROBU 1.0 - Strengthening the Core', the Company says it is investing in warehousing, fulfilment, ERP, IT infrastructure and process automation to improve scalability, operational efficiency and customer experience, and lists 'Expand warehousing, inventory and fulfilment capabilities' and 'Enhance digital, ERP and technology infrastructure' among its forward priorities - none of which carries a stated rupee amount, site or commissioning date. Under 'ROBU 2.0 - Building Proprietary Technology', expansion takes the form of in-house product development across four brands (SmartElex, EasyMech, SimplyFly, ProRange), with 120+ new SmartElex SKUs added this year (295 total), 6 new EasyMech drone frame designs introduced and a few more under development, 7 SimplyFly SKUs launched across 2 categories, and 650+ ProRange OEM SKUs added till this financial year; the Company also says it is extending across the technology lifecycle from component sourcing and prototyping to product development, testing and manufacturing, and is strengthening R&D and engineering capabilities. On funding, the Board did not recommend a dividend for FY2025-26 and retained profits 'to conserve the resources for the expansion of business in the long run'. No project name, site, capacity addition, commissioning timeline or capex quantum is disclosed anywhere in the routed text.
